comments.author: @nahlinbuckle1176
comments.text: Ok as an Aruban I just need to say some  things. There are no native flamingo’s on my island. So some of the pictures you show are not from the island. Those on Reinassance Island have been placed there and their wings clipped so they can’t fly away. The islands of Curacao and Bonaire do have native flamingo’s because they have natural saltpans, which Aruba does not have. I’m sure people won’t like what I had to say, but I really don’t like lies about my island!
